judge.name: Judge Hatem Elnahal
judge.title: Senior Legal Consultant & Judge
judge.bio: Judge Hatem Elnahal brings over 25 years of distinguished legal experience to Egypt Connect. Specializing in commercial and civil law, he has successfully handled over 1,000 cases throughout his career. His expertise spans business law, contract negotiation, property disputes, and complex civil litigation. Known for his thorough analysis and practical solutions, Judge Elnahal provides clear, actionable legal guidance to individuals and businesses alike.
